title: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2609.40071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital twins increasingly support downstream analytical tasks that depend on time-series data, motivating interest in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as scalable backbones. However, TSFMs are primarily pretrained for temporal continuation and often underperform on unseen tasks such as regression, and systematic empirical comparisons against state-of-the-art dedicated models in digital twin contexts remain limited. This paper makes three contributions. First, we benchmark five well-known TSFMs with frozen backbones on remaining useful life (RUL) prediction using the C-MAPSS dataset, finding that multivariate architectures substantially outperform univariate ones, particularly under varying operating conditions. translated_title: 将时间序列基础模型锚定于数字孪生拓扑以实现预测性维护
translated_abstract: 数字孪生日益支持依赖于时间序列数据的下游分析任务，这激发了人们将时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）作为可扩展骨干网络的兴趣。然而，时间序列基础模型主要是针对时间延续任务进行预训练的，在回归等未见过的任务上往往表现不佳，而且针对数字孪生场景中最先进的专用模型的系统性实证比较仍然有限。本文做出了三项贡献。首先，我们使用C-MAPSS数据集，在剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测任务上，对五个冻结骨干网络的知名时间序列基础模型进行了基准测试，发现多变量架构显著优于单变量架构，尤其是在不同运行条件下。这引出了一个更深层的问题：当跨通道依赖关系可以通过预训练权重、目标任务适配以及数字孪生派生的表示来建模时，各因素的贡献分别有多大，以及它们是否互补……
tldr: 该论文首次在数字孪生场景下系统性地对五个冻结骨干的时间序列基础模型在剩余使用寿命预测任务上进行基准测试，发现多变量架构显著优于单变量架构，并深入探讨了预训练权重、任务适配与数字孪生表示在建模跨通道依赖时的相对贡献与互补性。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks five frozen-backbone time-series foundation models on RUL prediction in digital twin contexts, showing that multivariate architectures substantially outperform univariate ones, and investigates the relative contributions and complementarity of pretrained weights, target-task adaptation, and digital twin-derived representations in modeling cross-channel dependencies.
